title: Socially Grounded Agentic AI: Coordinating Plural Perspectives through Social Theory

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not conduct empirical bias measurements, but instead proposes a theoretical evaluation framework for "pluralistic alignment." It proposes evaluating the representation of diverse perspectives (e.g., cultural, political, socioeconomic, and institutional) through trajectory-level analysis of multi-agent interaction traces, using criteria such as role fidelity, perspective coverage, deliberative quality, provenance transparency, and field sensitivity.
